shortDescription: Dow Inc. NYSE:DOW and CF Industries NYSE:CF are down 2.1% and 1.5%, respectively, in Friday's trading as KeyBanc initiated coverage on several chemical and agriculture companies amid a mixed macro backdrop, including improving ag fundamentals, Iran war tailwinds, rising interest rates, and limited…

children: are down 2.1% and 1.5%, respectively, in Friday's trading as KeyBanc initiated coverage on several chemical and agriculture companies amid a mixed macro backdrop, including improving ag fundamentals, Iran war tailwinds, rising interest rates, and limited leverage to the AI- and data center-driven boom, as well as a structural oversupply in petrochemicals that is not expected to ease anytime soon.

is started at Sector Weight with a $26 fair value by KeyBanc's Salvator Tiano, who points to benefits from the Iran war, including the potential for another major flareup that could prove more damaging to petrochemical supply, contrasted with the bank's structurally bearish outlook on polyethylene and expectations of significant earnings decline in profitability in the next few years.

is launched with an Underweight rating and $115 price target, as Tiano expects both nitrogen prices and the company's earnings to decline considerably in the next two years as the tailwinds from the Iran war fizzle and new supply, especially for ammonia, enters the market; he sees EBITDA moving significantly lower in 2027-28 to $2.5B-$2.7B, which takes into account improved ag fundamentals.

is initiated at Sector Weight with a $314 fair value, which the analyst believes is a beneficiary of industrial acceleration and investments in the semiconductor industry, yet with only a modest earnings growth rate in the next couple of years given a series of low-return projects and significant earnings dilution as NEOM comes online.

is launched at Overweight with a $542 PT as "the highest quality company within our cluster," whose valuation is far from inexpensive [but] well-deserved when considering the combination of the company's quality and the emerging tailwinds at its end markets, Tiano says, also seeing the company as one of the main beneficiaries of industrial demand acceleration as well as skyrocketing investments in electronics and semiconductors.

title: Dow, CF Industries slide as KeyBanc initiates chemical and agriculture stocks
